dedupe_keys.name: inter agency coordination for rural power restoration after hurricane helene qualitative interview dataset clemson university

description: This Harvard Dataverse deposit by Rui Shao, Kalyan Piratla, Chien-fei Chen, Mark Nartey Abuanor and Chao Fan of Clemson University is a qualitative interview dataset on inter-agency coordination for rural power restoration in the United States after Hurricane Helene. It holds three files: a zip of interview transcripts, the interview protocol as PDF and a metadata spreadsheet. The authors state that it is meant to help researchers and policymakers understand the ad hoc collaboration that underpins disaster recovery and to add qualitative context to quantitative studies of infrastructure resilience. It is described in a Scientific Data article (DOI 10.1038/s41597-026-06994-x), which users must cite. The files are free to download under CC BY 4.0; the current version 2.2 was updated in March 2026. Coverage is rural areas affected by Helene; the metadata page does not list the states or agencies interviewed. Caveats: interviews are qualitative accounts, so they inform process and agent rules, not giving restoration times, and the citation requirement applies to all uses. Simulation uses are coordination rules and restoration behaviour for emergency response and resilience models of power recovery. Related records: data-odin-real-time-outages-county and data-eagle-i-recorded-electricity-outages-us-counties give quantitative US outage records.
